# Tampa Bay Times

> > Florida's largest daily newspaper, delivering Pulitzer Prize-winning investigative journalism, local news, and community coverage across Tampa Bay, St. Petersburg, and surrounding areas.

The Tampa Bay Times is the flagship publication of Times Publishing Company, recognized for its in-depth investigative reporting on Florida issues including environmental concerns, public safety, government accountability, and worker protections. The site serves the greater Tampa Bay region with comprehensive news coverage, events, and educational resources.
